name: DG Set Control Panel
shortDescription: User-friendly control system to operate and monitor backup generators.
description: This panel is used for starting and stopping generators. It features a digital screen showing engine speed, battery level, oil pressure, and voltage, protecting the generator from overload.

specs.name: Power Capacity
specs.value: Designed for Heavy Industrial & Commercial Generators

features: Automatic start-stop functionality on power failure
Pre-failure warnings for low oil pressure or high temperature
Emergency stop switch for immediate shutdown
Clean, isolated wiring layout for easy maintenance

name: Electric Control Panel
shortDescription: Safe, reliable power distribution board for factories and buildings.
description: A standard distribution board used to route power and control machines safely. Designed with high-grade safety isolation features, eliminating shock hazards.

specs.name: Current Range
specs.value: Suitable for small workshops to large factories

specs.name: Enclosure
specs.value: Robust CRCA sheet metal steel casing

features: Fully customizable size and configuration
Shock-proof and fire-retardant design
Premium powder coating for rust and corrosion prevention
Optimal ventilation slots to prevent overheating
applications: Showrooms, retail shops, and commercial offices
Cold storage and food processing facilities

name: HT LT Panel
shortDescription: High-capacity switchgear panel to safely distribute high-voltage utility power.
description: Designed to distribute high-voltage electricity safely to various machinery groups in a plant. Includes automatic protection relays that cut off power during faults.

specs.name: Voltage Range
specs.value: 11kV High-tension input down to 415V Low-tension distribution

features: Specialized switchgear to handle high-voltage loads
Automatic trip action on short circuit or overload
Safety interlocks to prevent accidental contact
Double door steel enclosure with safety lock
applications: Steel rolling mills and cement plants

name: APFC Panel
shortDescription: Automatic Power Factor Correction panel to reduce energy bills and penalties.
description: This panel monitors inductive loads in real-time and switches capacitor banks to improve power factor, reducing electricity bills and avoiding reactive energy penalties.

specs.name: Heat Release
specs.value: Integrated cooling fans to maintain optimum temperature

features: Maintains power factor at 0.99 for maximum efficiency
Protects industrial machinery from voltage spikes
Automatic operation, switching capacitors as load changes
Saves money by avoiding utility reactive energy penalties
applications: Flour mills, oil mills, and heavy industries
Large offices, commercial complexes, and buildings

name: PCC Panel
shortDescription: Power Control Center panel for centralized power distribution.
description: Serves as the main distribution board for the entire plant. Enables safe and centralized monitoring and control of the complete facility's power supply.

specs.name: Safety Breaker
specs.value: Air Circuit Breakers (ACB) and Moulded Case Circuit Breakers (MCCB)

specs.name: Enclosure Safety
specs.value: IP54/IP55 rated dust and water resistant casing

features: High-conductivity copper busbars to handle large currents
Robust heat dissipation design for continuous duty
Digital metering showing active line currents and voltages
Isolated cubicle structure for enhanced safety

name: Fire Hydrant Panel
shortDescription: Emergency control panel to run firefighting water pumps automatically.
description: Automatically triggers firefighting water pumps when a drop in water line pressure is detected, ensuring immediate water supply in case of fire emergencies.

specs.name: Start Type
specs.value: Automatic Star-Delta or Soft Starter to prevent power surges

specs.name: Sensors Connection
specs.value: Water pressure sensor based automatic start

specs.name: Alarm Support
specs.value: Integrated hooter / siren for audible alert during fire activation

features: Launches pump automatically when pipeline pressure drops
Triggers alarm to alert occupants immediately
Auxiliary battery support for control unit
Weatherproof IP65 enclosure protection
applications: Hotels, commercial malls, and high-rise buildings
